author: Mark Atwood
text: Security pass (kimi-k3) adds: the string case cannot express numeric range at all — '99999999999999999999999' (all digits) wraps bash arithmetic to negative and sleep exits 1 immediately -> hot loop; '08'/'09' abort the whole script at the arithmetic line in non-interactive bash (supervisor restart -> crash-loop, one full API/bd cycle per death). Fix recommendation sharpened: decimal-normalize + range-check numerically before the loop (CYCLE_MIN=$((10#$CYCLE_MIN)) then reject <1 or above a sane cap); the case pattern alone cannot express this.
